definitions.explanation: The sense of seeing; the ability to perceive with the eyes.

notes:
{視覚|しかく} refers to the sense of sight as a physiological and perceptual faculty. It is more technical/formal than ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) and is used in scientific, medical, and academic contexts.

THE FIVE SENSES (⟦{五感|ごかん}→五感：05698_gokan⟧):
- {視覚|しかく}: sight
- ⟦{聴覚|ちょうかく}→聴覚：13911_choukaku⟧: hearing
- ⟦{嗅覚|きゅうかく}→嗅覚：04422_kyuukaku⟧: smell
- ⟦{味覚|みかく}→味覚：04424_mikaku⟧: taste
- ⟦{触覚|しょっかく}→触覚：04426_shokkaku⟧: touch
